info.title: AccSaber Reloaded API
info.description: REST API for the AccSaber Reloaded platform - an accuracy-based leaderboard system for Beat Saber.

tags.description: Service health and status checks

post.summary: Link a Discord account to a player

post.description: Unbans a previously banned user, restoring them to leaderboards and rankings. Recalculation runs asynchronously.
Refreshes a single player's profile from BeatLeader and ScoreSaber.
Bans a user, excluding them from leaderboards and rankings. Ranking recalculation runs asynchronously. Profile remains accessible.
Triggers an async refresh of all player profiles from BeatLeader and ScoreSaber, updating names, avatars, countries, and activity status.

post.description: Reverses score reassignments and reactivates the secondary user

Merges all curated links that haven't been merged yet. Recalculation runs once after all merges complete.

Recalculate total XP for all users

post.description: Recalculates weighted AP per category for every user, then updates all rankings.

post.summary: Recalculate raw AP for all scores
post.description: In-place AP recalc across all ranked difficulties. Reassigns ranks and updates stats per category.

post.summary: Recalculate raw AP for a single difficulty
post.description: Versioned recalc: creates new score versions, reassigns ranks, updates stats.
Runs raw AP recalc then weighted AP recalc sequentially.

get.description: Returns a player profile by user ID. Optionally include all category statistics.
Returns the difference between the most recent statistics and the last statistics before 24h ago. Returns 204 No Content if no baseline exists (new player or no activity before 24h ago)
Returns active category statistics for a player by category code (tech_acc, standard_acc, true_acc) (defaults to 'overall')
Returns all versioned statistics for a player over a time range, sorted by time ascending. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months)
Returns all active category statistics plus XP breakdown for a player
Paginated list of a player's active scores, optionally filtered by category and/or song name
Returns all versioned scores for a player on a specific map difficulty over a time range, sorted by time ascending. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months)

get.summary: Get user score by song hash
get.description: Returns a player's active score on a specific map difficulty, looked up by song hash, difficulty (EASY, NORMAL, HARD, EXPERT, EXPERT_PLUS) and characteristic (defaults to Standard)
Returns daily ranking snapshots for a player in a category over a time range, sorted by time ascending. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months)
Returns a player's previous names, most recent first

get.summary: Get unplayed maps for a user
get.description: Paginated list of ranked difficulties the user has no active score on, with the same filters as the maps/difficulties endpoint

get.summary: Get user progress in a campaign
Get user profile by platform link
get.description: Returns a player profile by BeatLeader URL, ScoreSaber URL, or numeric ID. Optionally include all category statistics.
Scores ranked by highest 115 note streak. Optional category filter.
Map difficulties ranked by number of superseded scores (improvements). Optional category filter.

get.summary: Users with most improvements on a single map
get.description: Users ranked by most superseded scores on any single map difficulty. Optional category filter.
Users ranked by total number of superseded scores across all maps. Optional category filter.
Users ranked by number of completed milestones.
Scores ranked by highest AP. Optional category filter.
Map difficulties ranked by average AP across all scores. Optional category filter and minimum score threshold.
Count of score submissions over a time range. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months). Ranges over 65 days are downsampled to weekly.
Distribution of active scores across categories.
Distribution of active players by country.
Distribution of players by headset model (from most recent score).
Count of new player registrations over a time range. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months). Ranges over 65 days are downsampled to weekly.
Running total of tracked scores over a time range. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months). Ranges over 65 days are downsampled to weekly.
Running total of active accounts over a time range. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months). Ranges over 65 days are downsampled to weekly.

get.summary: List staff users, optionally filtered by active status

get.description: Full map list including complexity, submitter, and vote breakdowns
Full difficulty list including complexity, submitter, and all vote breakdowns
Paginated list of all active votes sorted by most recently updated
All map difficulties that have been removed from the ranking system (active=false), ordered by most recently updated
Returns the AI-suggested complexity for an active RANKED difficulty identified by songHash + difficulty + characteristic. Returns a null complexity if BeatLeader has no AI accuracy for this map.
Returns a single batch with its difficulties

Returns a Beat Saber playlist JSON file containing all ranked maps for the specified category. The syncURL field allows mod managers to auto-refresh the playlist. Prefer the /{category} path variant for standalone Beat Saber compatibility.

Returns a Beat Saber playlist JSON file containing all ranked maps for the specified category. The syncURL field allows mod managers to auto-refresh the playlist. This path-based variant is compatible with standalone Beat Saber.
Returns all active score modifiers

List users who have completed a milestone

List all milestones in a set
Get set group links for a set
Get set links for a group
Get completion stats for all active milestones

get.description: Paginated map list, optionally filtered by category, status, and/or search (matches song name, song author, or mapper)
Returns a map with all its active difficulties

get.summary: Complexity version history for a map

get.description: Returns a map by its song hash with active difficulties, optionally filtered by difficulty level (EASY, NORMAL, HARD, EXPERT, EXPERT_PLUS)
Paginated difficulty list with map metadata, filterable by category, status, complexity range, and/or search (matches song name, song author, or mapper)
Returns a single map difficulty with public metadata; complexity is only included for RANKED difficulties, vote counts and criteria status only for non-RANKED
Returns the active aggregate statistics (maxAp, minAp, averageAp, totalScores) for a difficulty
Returns all versioned statistics for a difficulty over a time range, sorted by time ascending. Units: h (hours), d (days), w (weeks), mo (months)
Paginated scores with player info for a specific difficulty, sorted by score descending. Optionally filter by country code (e.g. ES, GB) and/or player name search
Paginated scores for a difficulty looked up by BeatLeader or ScoreSaber leaderboard ID (provide exactly one)
Returns scores above and below a player on a difficulty leaderboard. Looked up by BeatLeader or ScoreSaber leaderboard ID. If fewer scores exist above/below, the remainder shifts to the other side.
Returns a flat list of all ranked difficulties with song hash, difficulty level, and current complexity. Cached until ranked difficulties change.
Returns a map by its BeatSaver code with active difficulties, optionally filtered by difficulty level (EASY, NORMAL, HARD, EXPERT, EXPERT_PLUS)
Paginated global rankings for a category, sorted by ranking ascending. Optionally filter by player name search, HMD, or inactive status.
Paginated rankings filtered by country for a category, sorted by AP descending. Optionally filter by player name search, HMD, or inactive status.
Paginated XP rankings, sorted by total XP descending. Optional country, name search, HMD, and inactive status filters.
Returns service status and current timestamp

Returns a single category with its associated curves
Calculate raw AP from a score percentage, complexity, and category. Optionally provide a userId to also compute the weighted AP for that score's position.
Paginated batch list, optionally filtered by status and/or batch name search
Returns a batch with all its assigned map difficulties
Finds user pairs with 8+ identical scores (same map difficulty AND same score value). Primary is the user with more BeatLeader scores.
